purpose: Report a decision or arrangement as established.
keywords: Dictionary-form / ない-form verb + ことになる.
It has been arranged that I will transfer to Osaka next month.
It was decided to hold the meeting on Friday.
It has been decided that we will not travel this year.
Foreground a choice or report an arrangement
formation: Dictionary-form / ない-form verb + ことになる.
restrictions: The expression backgrounds who decided; the speaker may still have participated.
mistake: It does not always mean the outcome happened by pure chance.
